Bill.BriefDescription: Studying state policies on controlled substances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to studying state policies on controlledsubstances; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Washington state institute for publicpolicy is directed to investigate and report to the legislature byJanuary 1, 2007, on the fiscal and other costs and benefits to thevarious governments and people of the state of Washington from theimplementation of current Washington state policies on controlledsubstances, excluding alcohol, tobacco, and pharmaceuticals.
